newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo truck Jan deliveries rise in U.S.. [CORRECTED 17:45 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Volvo truck Jan deliveries rise in U.S.. [CORRECTED 17:45 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to make clear that figures refer to the U.S. market only.)
Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Monday that its deliveries of heavy trucks in the U.S. rose to 1,300 in January which was 34 percent higher than January 1996.
"Even order intake increased by about a similar amount, around 30 percent in January," Volvo Trucks spokesman Stefan Lorentzson told Reuters.
Sales of Volvo truck D12 were also good during the month.
The market share of the D12 in Volvo Truck reached 30 percent in January which was a strong increase from the same period a year ago when it held less than 20 percent of the market.
The target is to retain 24-25 percent of the market share in 1997.
"It is still, however, too early to draw any conclusions from the month," Lorentzson said.
